title: A refused merge does not say what to rerun
what: The refusal names both steps (run relay gate, then delegate:checker); relay check show adds a line '<N> non-inert files changed after the mark' when step_mark would refuse.
why: The refusal after files changed behind the check mark names only a new check; the next refusal is the stale gate. And relay check show prints open 0 with no hint that commits after the mark will block the merge.
failing_case: Trial: merge refused with '...not inert; check again'; the gate also had to be rerun (merge.py step_gate refuses next); relay check show printed gate exit 0, mark open 0, outside 0 while the merge was refused.
pass_cases: The refusal text contains both gate and check; check show on a branch with a non-inert change after the mark prints the count and names the files; on a clean branch the output is unchanged.
